description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Undersea Sensor Systems Inc. is hiring Embedded Software Engineers to develop and support software for maritime and defense systems. The role includes software design, coding, integration, testing, troubleshooting, and collaboration with multidisciplinary teams.
Embedded Software Engineer developing and integrating airborne receiver software, supporting product enhancements, verification, and hardware/software troubleshooting

Responsibilities:
• Develop, maintain, integrate, and troubleshoot embedded software for existing and next-generation electronic systems, including airborne receiver technologies
• Support new product development and enhancements to legacy software systems
• Participate in software requirements definition, architecture and design, coding, integration, testing, and technical documentation
• Collaborate with hardware engineers, systems engineers, program management, project teams, and customer representatives to develop and deliver effective technical solutions
• Perform hardware/software integration and troubleshooting to identify and resolve complex technical issues
• Participate in software design reviews, technical discussions, and project meetings
• Support software verification, system integration, and testing activities at company facilities and, as needed, at government or other offsite test facilities
• Contribute to continuous improvement in software development practices, quality, and engineering processes
• Take on additional responsibilities aligned with your experience, skills, and assigned projects

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline
• Experience in embedded software engineering, embedded systems, or a related technical field, with responsibilities and level determined by the specific opportunity
• Foundational or demonstrated experience with software development, programming, debugging, or testing through academic projects, internships, co-ops, or professional experience
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and hardware/software troubleshooting skills
• Ability to communicate technical concepts effectively and collaborate with cross-functional teams
• Initiative, adaptability, and the ability to work independently while contributing to a team
• Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance, as required for the specific position. Security clearance eligibility requirements apply

Preferred:
• Embedded software development using C and/or C++
• Embedded Linux or other real-time or embedded operating systems
• Digital signal processing concepts, including analog-to-digital and digital-to-analog conversion, filtering, and signal analysis
• Hardware/software integration, debugging, and test equipment such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, function generators, logic analyzers, and spectrum analyzers
• C# or other software development languages
• MATLAB or related engineering analysis tools
• Radio frequency (RF) systems or related technologies
• Cryptography or secure communications
• IP networking and network protocols
• FPGA development using VHDL or Verilog
• Software verification, automated testing, or software development lifecycle practices
